messages:
sam: Heads-up: minimal repro for ESM/CJS bundler interop that breaks auth on retries in edge bundles.

ivy: short steps?

sam: 1) git clone https://example/repro-edge-esm
2) npm ci && npm run build:edge:vite (produces dist/esm)
3) npm run serve:edge (local shim)
4) curl -i -H "Authorization: Bearer X" http://localhost:8787/api/proxy -> first request 200, retry 403

sam: root cause: Vite/Rollup sometimes inlines a helper that uses `new Request(req)` instead of `req.clone()`. In our edge shim that can lose header iterators, so Authorization is dropped on retry. CJS builds keep clone() and work.

noah: did you try import style variations?

sam: yes. default ESM import sometimes triggers the problematic helper. `import * as SDK from 'redwood-sdk'` can avoid it in a few cases but not reliable.

ale: proposed fix?

sam: short-term: make SDK use clone when present and fallback to explicit header copy. tiny snippet I validated in repro:
```js
function safeClone(req){
  if (typeof req.clone === 'function') return req.clone();
  const headers = new Headers();
  for (const [k,v] of (req.headers||[])) headers.set(k,v);
  return new Request(req.url,{method:req.method,headers,body:req.body});
}
```

ivy: please open an issue and assign eng-runtime + devex, add repro and CI that builds vite/rollup/webpack.

sam: done: redwood/sdk#4350, branch devex/edge-esm-clone-fallback pushed with CI matrix and tests.

devx-bot: Issue redwood/sdk#4350 created  assigned to @noah and @eng-runtime. CI triggered. :white_check_mark:

noah: I'll review for streaming body semantics and edge-side differences. If safe we'll merge and cut a patch.

sam: added a temporary note in docs: "If you bundle for edge and see 403 after retries, try namespace import `import * as SDK` or upgrade to the next SDK patch."

ivy: great catch  saved a potential support case.
